/.title: Nutrikit — Nutrition API for food search, meal logging and barcodes
/.description: Turn text, voice, photos, barcodes and nutrition labels into matched foods, real portions and up to 33 nutrients. One API key, a tiny SDK, 2,000 free tokens a month.

/pricing.title: Pricing — Nutrikit Nutrition API
/pricing.description: Start free with 2,000 tokens a month, no card needed. Simple token pricing for food search, meal logging, barcode lookup, label parsing and meal plans.

/docs.title: Documentation — Nutrikit Nutrition API
/docs.description: Quick start, authentication and guides for every Nutrikit feature: food search, nutrients, meal logging, barcodes, labels, meal plans and the JavaScript SDK.

/docs/reference.title: API reference — Nutrikit Nutrition API
/docs/reference.description: Every Nutrikit REST endpoint with parameters, request and response schemas, errors and token costs, generated from the OpenAPI specification.

/playground.title: API playground — Nutrikit
/playground.description: Try the Nutrikit nutrition API in your browser: search foods, log a meal from text, look up a barcode or parse a nutrition label, and see the JSON response.
